thread:
toni: Starting POC with Cascade. They want Redwood Private in their VPC, BYOK via HSM, and a cert rotation plan. Need a minimal checklist I can send to their security team.

lee: Quick checklist: CSR (PEM) or CA chain, KMS provider + CMK vs HSM, wrapped-key import preferred, allowed CIDRs and bootstrap IPs, SAML metadata if SSO, infra contact.

nina: Notes on key options: 1) CMK: customer keeps CMK, attach Redwood role for kms:GenerateDataKey/kms:Decrypt. 2) HSM import: we provide import token + wrapping key, customer wraps PKCS#8 in their HSM and uploads wrapped blob to presigned S3. We never accept raw private keys.

sec-bot: Compliance asks for example CMK policy, HSM attestation (vendor cert/FIPS), rotation cadence (they asked 90 days), and CloudTrail setup for audit logs.

lee: Example one-liner to send them: "Redwood supports BYOK via CMK integration or HSM import. For CMK attach the provided Redwood role to your key policy (we use envelope encryption and CloudTrail for audits). For HSM import, request an import token from Redwood, wrap your PKCS#8 private key with the provided wrapping key inside your HSM, upload to the presigned S3 URL, and we import without ever seeing plaintext. Also provide CSR PEM for control-plane TLS, VPC subnet IDs, and CIDR allowlist for bootstrap."

toni: Perfect. I'll send that and request CSR + CMK policy by EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: Created ticket POC-7021 assigned to lee, nina.

nina: I'll draft the import-token doc and sample commands for wrapping/upload.

toni: Thanks — will update Cascade and schedule bootstrap window after IPs land.
